defs.def: to make sth longer or larger 使伸长；扩大；扩展

ex.t: 雪——已经受到气候变暖的威胁——随着温度升高会从大气中吸收不同的化学物质，从而改变了它那种清冷的气味。

ex.s: It extends the understanding of oneself.
ex.t: 关于《流动的盛宴》这本书我们知道什么？

ex.s: When my mother saw my creations, she told me how creative my designs were. ___34___ I learned a lot about how to extend the life of objects and transform them into something new and useful.
ex.t: 当母亲看到我的作品时，她说我的设计很有创意。___34___我学到了很多关于如何延长物品寿命并将其转化为崭新有用之物的知识。

ex.s: Policymakers should start thinking now about how to make sure the appearance of driverless vehicles doesn’t extend the worst aspects of the car-controlled transportation system we have today.
ex.t: 了解这些原因可以使我们审视自己的行为，纠正不良习惯。

defs.def: to make sth last longer 延长；使延期
to make a business, an idea, an influence, etc. cover more areas or operate in more places 扩大 … 的范围（或影响）

ex.s: The plan will extend protection to a significant number of areas that ___58___ (be)previously unprotected, bringing many of the existing protected areas for giant pandas under one authority ___59___ (increase)effectiveness and reduce inconsistencies in management.
ex.t: 该计划将把保护扩展到大量此前___58___（曾是）未受保护的区域，将许多现有的大熊猫保护区纳入统一管理，___59___（提高）有效性并减少管理上的不一致。

defs.def: to relate to or include sb/sth 适用于；包括

ex.s: For some days afterwards, groups of eyeing and pointing men stood about many a building, looking at long zig-zag cracks that extended from the roofs of buildings to the ground.
ex.t: 接下来的一些日子里，许多人成群结队地站在许多栋房屋前张望指点，看着从屋顶一直延伸到地面的那些弯弯曲曲的裂缝。

ex.s: Extending south from parts of what we now know as Mexico into Central America, __________________________________.
ex.t: 向南延伸，从我们现在所知的墨西哥部分地区一直到中美洲，__________________________________。

ex.s: It extended 4 ______________ and caused us to realise that the universe is a far larger place than we ever imagined.
ex.t: 它延伸了 4 ______________，让我们意识到宇宙远比我们想象的要大得多。

defs.def: to cover a particular area, distance or length of time 涉及（范围）；延伸（距离）；延续（时间）

ex.s: Learning to learn When you are extending or accepting an invitation, pay special attention to the following information:the date and time, what to bring, where to meet, etc.
ex.t: 学会学习 在你发出或接受邀请时，要特别注意以下信息：日期和时间、需要带什么、见面的地点等等。

ex.s: An extended metaphor refers to a comparison between two things that is developed at length over many lines of text, or throughout an entire work of literature.
ex.t: 延展隐喻是指将两个事物之间的比较，在文本的多行句子中，或贯穿整部文学作品进行长时间的发展。

defs.def: to make sth reach sth or stretch 使达到；使延伸
to stretch part of your body, especially an arm or a leg, away from yourself 伸展，舒展，展开（尤指手臂或腿）
to offer or give sth to sb 提供；给予
to make sb/sth use all their effort, abilities, supplies, etc. 使竭尽全力
